F@@S: As the UI/UX designer for the Quick Cab project, my role was to create a seamless and user-friendly experience for User, focusing on safety and convenience, particularly for female users. Here's how I contributed to the project:
I researched what people needed, especially women, to feel safe while traveling.
I worked with the team to come up with ideas for the app's features and layout.
I created simple versions of the app to test how easy it was to use.
I chose colors, fonts, and icons to make the app look nice and easy to use.
I talked a lot with the team and helped make sure the app looked and worked the same on different devices.
